_comment: User-editable. The owner's own skills, used by the {{CORE_COMPETENCIES}} slot: the engine surfaces the subset of these that the posting actually asks for (matched against extracted keyword canonicals), ordered by relevance. It never invents skills you don't have. `fallback` is shown verbatim when the posting overlaps none of them, so the line always fills.
fallback: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, SQL, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Agile development
